title: Add the ordinary work-session control route alongside the legacy turn channel
outcome: Provide grant-free named-root, evaluator and observation/registered-verification association over the existing host channel, preserving legacy turn behavior and history for the coordinated consumer transition.
acceptance: The ordinary work-session route uses fixed host project/session/actor context and the current connection fence, without any control-session phase, routing token, grant, Evaluate/Begin or old-operation settlement requirement

Named-root binding/reads, evaluator reads and host observation/registered-verification recording work on real retained issued, begun, expired and completed grants including Exited sessions; wire and work/source/claim authority negatives stay enforced with no unintended writes
The legacy control channel retains its behavior and historical records remain readable as stored; ordinary startup and requests neither erase, expire nor replay old turn operations

Documentation describes the gate-free host route and its unchanged evidence/authority limits; the exact reviewed input passes the normal full gate and is landed/installed for TermAl's coordinated switch

completion.summary: Landed and installed 8b5495eb on Greg's direct word, with the exact Mac full gate PASS (12/12 stages, 3936 pass, 0 fail, matching input fingerprint) and readiness ready on all six live stores. The independent acceptance evaluator was refused before spawning because TermAl lacked an eligible named-root sighting (HTTP 409, recorded once, defect w-a7f0d25bf103); under Greg's current rule evaluation enforcement is OFF and this does not block landing or completion. The evaluation remains absent, not passed.
